"""Inventory helpers."""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


@dataclass
class Item:
    name: str
    count: int = 0
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def label(self, /, upper: bool = False) -> str:
        text = f"{self.name}: {self.count!r}"
        return text.upper() if upper else text


type Pair[T] = tuple[T, T]


def classify(item: Item) -> str:
    match item:
        case Item(count=0):
            return "empty"
        case Item(name=str(n), count=c) if c > 100:
            return f"bulk {n}"
        case _:
            return "normal"


async def total(items: list[Item]) -> int:
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    if (n := len(items)) == 0:
        return 0
    squares = [i.count ** 2 for i in items if i.count > 0]
    try:
        return sum(squares) // n
    except (ZeroDivisionError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("bad") from exc
    finally:
        pass

# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'json'

module Inventory
  Item = Struct.new(:name, :count) do
    def bulk?
      count > 100
    end
  end

  class Store
    include Enumerable
    attr_reader :limit

    def initialize(limit = 10)
      @limit = limit
      @items = {}
    end

    def add(item)
      raise ArgumentError, "store is full" if @items.size >= limit

      @items[item.name] = item
      self
    end

    def each(&block)
      @items.each_value(&block)
    end

    def summary
      map { |i| "#{i.name}=#{i.count}" }.join(", ")
    end

    def self.level(count)
      case count
      when 0 then :empty
      when 1..100 then :normal
      else :bulk
      end
    end
  end
end

store = Inventory::Store.new(4)
[["bolt", 120], ["nut", 4]].each do |name, count|
  store.add(Inventory::Item.new(name, count))
end
puts store.summary
puts Inventory::Store.level(store.sum(&:count)).to_s

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

readonly LOG_DIR="${LOG_DIR:-/tmp/logs}"
declare -A counts
counts[bolt]=120
counts[nut]=4

# Print a message with a timestamp.
log() {
  local level="$1"
  shift
  printf '%s [%s] %s\n' "$(date +%T)" "$level" "$*" >&2
}

classify() {
  local n=$1
  if (( n > 100 )); then
    echo bulk
  elif [[ $n -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo empty
  else
    echo normal
  fi
}

for name in "${!counts[@]}"; do
  level=$(classify "${counts[$name]}")
  case "$level" in
    bulk) log INFO "$name is bulk" ;;
    empty|normal) log DEBUG "$name: $level" ;;
    *) log WARN "unknown" ;;
  esac
done

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
total=0
while read -r line; do
  total=$((total + ${#line}))
done < <(printf '%s\n' "${!counts[@]}")
cat <<EOF > "$LOG_DIR/summary.txt"
total=$total
EOF
echo "done: $total" | tee -a "$LOG_DIR/run.log"
